chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin Pasian' hong it tate na hihna uh tawh Pasian a ettehte hita un.
Khris in ei hong itin eite' taangin Pasian' kiangah a namtui mawhphel biakpiakna a luui dingin amahmah hong kipiak mah bangin note zong itna sungah na nungta un.
Ahih hangin nulepa tatkhialhna, thanghuai gamtatna namkim, duhhop huaihamna, cihte pen mi siangthote' lakah genin zong neih vetloh ding a kilawm thu ahi hi.
A kilawm lo ahi, a zumhuai gamtat luhek, a haivai thugen lagen leh a thanghuai ciamnuih gualnop, cihte omsak kei unla lungdam kohna neizaw un.

A hang pen ciantak na theih ding uh thu ah: nulepa tatkhialhna a bawl mi, a thanghuai-in a gamta mi, a duhhop a huaiham mi (lam khatin ci lehang, milim a bia mi), hih bang mi ahih nakleh Khris leh Pasian' kumpigam sungah luah bangmah nei lo ding hi.
Kammal a hawmpite' khemsa-in om kei un. A hang pen hih thute hangin thumanglo mite' tungah Pasian' hehna tung hi.
Tua ahih manin tua mite tawh pangkhawm kha kei un.
A hang pen hun khat lai-in note khuamial na hi uh a, tu-in ahihleh Topa' sungah khuavak na hi uh hi. Khuavak tate' bangin nungta gamtazaw un.
(A hang pen a hoih, a dik, a maan a kici khempeuh khuavak pana gahkhia ahi hi).
Bang in Topa lungkimsak cih khentel un.
Kimanna neilo khuamial nasepte ah kihelkha kei unla tuate pholakzaw un.
A hang pen a simtham-a a septe uh genkhiat ding nangawn zumhuai hi.
Ahi zongin khuavak in na khempeuh hong pholak ciangin muhtheih hong suak ding hi.
A hang pen muhtheih a suak peuhmah khuavak ahi hi. Tua hangin hih na kici hi: “Ihmu mi aw, khanglo inla misite' kiangpan thoto in. Tua hileh Khris in khuavak hong taan ding hi.”
Tua hi a, mihai bang hilo-in mipil bangin na nuntakzia limtak kidawm un.
Hunlenite sia ahih manin hunpha laksiam zatsiam un.
Hih thu hangin haitat kei unla Topa' deihna bang hiam cih theitel un.
Lengtui khamna pen cilesa uangtatna ahih manin tuaci kei unla Kha tawh kidimin om un.
Phatna late, biakpiak late, leh kha late tawh khatlekhat kiho unla na lungsim tak uh tawh Topa la sakin tumging la-awte phuah un.
A tawntungin leh na khempeuh hangin Pa Pasian' tungah i Topa Jesu Khris' min tawh hehpih phat un.
Khris zahtakna tawh khatlekhat na kiniamlut tek un.
Zite aw, Topa' kiangah na niamlut mah bangun nomau' pasal tek' kiangah na tuaci un.
Banghanghiam cihleh Khris pen ama' pumpi ahi pawlpi' lutang, amahmah pawlpi' Honpa ahih bang lianin pasal zong zi' lutang ahi hi.
Tu-in pawlpi pen Khris' kiangah a niamlut mah bangin zite zong na khempeuh ah na pasalte uh' kiangah niamlut un.
Pasalte aw, Khris in pawlpi itin pawlpi' ading amahmah a kipiak bangin na zite uh it un.
Tua bangin Khris a kipiak pen siansuahna tui ahi Pasian' kammal tawh pawlpi silsiangin a siansuah theih nading hi a,
pawlpi a siangtho leh sitbaanglo ahih nading, pawnsia leh satonna cih bang om lo, tua dan nam khatpeuh zong om lo-in amahmah' kiangah thupitak a ap theih nading, ahi hi.
Tua dan mahin pasalte in a zite uh amau' pumpi bangin a it ding uh ahi hi. A zi a it mi amahmah a ki-it ahi hi.
A hang pen ama' cilesa pumpi a mudah kuamah om lo a, Khris in pawlpi' tungah a bawl bangin pumpi pen anletui kivakin kidon tek hi.
A hang pen eite ama' pumpi ah pumpi na tek i hi hi.
“Hih thu hangin pasal in a pa leh a nu nusia-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, tua nihte sikhat sakhat suak ding uh hi.”
Hih thusim pen thuthukpi hi a, hih thu kong gen ciangin Khris leh pawlpi a kawk nuam ka hi hi.
Himah taleh note khat ciat in na zi tek uh nomau na ki-it bangun it unla, zite in zong na pasal tek uh thupibawl hamtang un.
